rounds.reason: Initial complete proxy reconstruction of the freeway dance take for first render feedback.
rounds.report:
Representation level: L1 (proxy). CineRecon Three.js sampled-frame baseline (not a Blender-protocol reproduction).

Observed (24 reference samples, 0-23.98 s): a sunny elevated freeway jammed with cars, a concrete median barrier and outer walls, letterboxed 2.55:1 picture. A single continuous steadicam-style take (whip pan near 2 s, no hard cuts identified). Opening: a maroon car facing camera with dancers on its hood/roof, a man in a mustard jacket and red cap over a blonde woman in red against the hood, a woman in blue and a man in a light-blue shirt dancing at left. Camera whips past the couple and looks down the lane; a man in white shirt, red tie and black trousers climbs out of the driver door of a teal car, walks toward camera, turns right past a white car where a woman in purple kicks from the window, jumps onto the median, dances on it with arms spread, jumps down, crosses the right-hand lanes, walks/dances along a lane gap past a man in a yellow shirt and black cap leaning out of a grey car, reaches a car whose door opens; a woman in a denim shirt and pink headband steps out and the two walk toward the retreating camera side by side (man image-left, woman image-right). Background people dance and wave on car roofs.

Geometry: cars are box body + dark glass cabin box + roof slab + cylinder wheels; the teal car driver door and the denim woman's car passenger door are separate hinged groups. People are articulated proxies (box torso/pelvis, sphere head, hair/cap/headband/tie proxies, two-segment arms and legs, box feet) with root, spine, head, shoulder, elbow, hip and knee joints. Freeway: road slab, median box, wall boxes, neighbouring jammed roadways with simplified cars, sphere tree clumps, vertex-colour sky dome. Letterbox bars are black planes parented to the camera.

Articulation/timing (inferred between samples): teal door opens 2.6-3.3 s, closes 5.8-6.4 s; man exits 3.3-5.2 s, walks 5.6-8.3 s, jumps onto the median 8.9-9.75 s, dances there until 11.8 s, jumps down 11.8-12.25 s, crosses lanes 12.5-13.6 s, walks/turns in the gap 14-17 s, leans on the car at 17.7 s; car door opens 18.0-18.7 s; woman exits 18.3-19.8 s; door closes 20.45-21.3 s; pair walks toward camera 20.8-24 s. Walk cycles and dance waves are analytic functions of absolute time; every transform is set from time on each call (deterministic, seekable). Camera follows a Hermite spline through per-sample position/target keys with a constant 37.4 deg vertical FOV.

Inference vs observation: subject positions in one consistent 3D layout were inferred from the 2D samples. The car geography in the samples is partly contradictory, so some background car placements and the hero's in-between paths are approximations. All motion between samples is inferred.

Render feedback received: none yet (initial submission). Remaining uncertainties: absolute subject scales per frame, exact camera heights, crowd counts, and colours under the harness lighting.
